description: Assemble a token-budgeted, task-aware context package with explicit gap declaration. Runs multi-angle search, coverage check, and temporal analysis internally.

context_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for the context package (default: 600). After expiry, refine_context will fail.

include_ids.description: Memory IDs that MUST be included

intent.description: What you are about to do — drives section prioritization

queries.description: Explicit search queries (recommended). If omitted, queries are auto-generated from intent.

token_budget.description: Max tokens for context package. Auto-scales by strategy if omitted: task_answer=4000, decision_support=6000, historical_review=8000, exploration=3000.

name: velixar_prepare_context
